intro: Meats to Orgrimmar is a short introductory logistical quest offered by Zargh at the Crossroads. He asks young orc and troll adventurers to take a package of prime Barrens meat to the settlement's wind rider master, Devrak, introducing them to flight transport back to the Horde capital.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have some choice cuts of meat that I want to send to a friend. Her name is Gryshka, the innkeeper in Orgrimmar. Will you deliver the meat for me?
The fastest way to Orgrimmar is on a wind rider. Take the meats to the Crossroads wind rider master, Devrak, and speak with him about transport to Orgrimmar.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You need to get somewhere fast? Then you're talking to the right orc!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have to get this meat to Orgrimmar? That is no problem. For a small fee, my wind rider can take you there.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
